SuppressWelcomeTab.title: Suppress Welcome Tab
SuppressWelcomeTab.description: Prevents the welcome tab from opening on first install

SilentLoginEnabled.title: Silent Login Enabled
SilentLoginEnabled.description: Enables silent authentication without user interaction

Domain.title: Domain
Domain.description: Your domain for authentication and authorization (e.g., company.com)

CheckAuthIntervalHours.title: Check Auth Interval
CheckAuthIntervalHours.description: Interval in hours for checking authentication status

MinerVisibility.title: Miner Visibility
MinerVisibility.description: Controls extension UI visibility for background-capture users: 'full' (default), 'minimal', or 'headless'. Only honored when the user's JWT carries a background-capture product entitlement; otherwise ignored.

OptimizeCollectorAuthRecoveryEnabled.title: Optimize Collector Auth Recovery Enabled
OptimizeCollectorAuthRecoveryEnabled.description: Enables the rollout gate for on-demand and event-driven Optimize/DW collector auth recovery

OptimizeCollectorRefreshAwareRequestPath.title: Optimize Collector Refresh-Aware Request Path Enabled
OptimizeCollectorRefreshAwareRequestPath.description: Enables the rollout gate for refresh-aware Optimize/DW collector request paths

AllowedDomains.title: Allowed Domains
AllowedDomains.description: List of domains that users are allowed to authenticate to (e.g., ["company.com", "subsidiary.com"]). Users attempting to access workspaces with domains not in this list will be blocked and logged out immediately. An empty array will block all domains. Omit this field entirely to allow all domains.
